text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During lunch, I spot Daiwa Scarlet
looking
flustered.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! Ugh... This doesn't
make sense! I
don't even eat that much!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So why does my uniform feel so tight?
Trainer! I
need to do some training,
pronto!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrrr! That's the plan,
you carrot-brain!
Just
don't say it out loud!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After exercising furiously—in both senses
of the
word—Daiwa Scarlet successfully
returns to her
usual weight.
